name: FretNot
tagline: A clip-on that projects lasers onto a guitar's fretboard to show where each chord's fingers go.
problem: Beginner guitarists struggle to learn finger positions for chords.
solution: An ESP32 with lasers clips on the guitar; a web app parses song lyrics and chords over Bluetooth and steps through them automatically.
demo_moment: Team-described: load a song and follow the projected chord shapes.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “IEEE SFU Prize Track” among 217 submissions.
Acts as training wheels until muscle memory takes over.

lessons: Put the guidance on the instrument, not on a screen.
